## Published Book & Biomedical Research
1. **Published Book — *From Healing to Superhuman: How Brain-Computer Interfaces Restore Broken Bodies and Enhance Daily Life***
   - **Author**: Aklavya Kumar
   - **Availability**: Published globally on Amazon
   - **Synopsis**: Examines the engineering, medical rehabilitation pathways, cognitive enhancement applications, and bioethics of invasive and non-invasive Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs).
2. **Formal Research Paper — *CogniTrack: An EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interface for Objective Monitoring of Cognitive Fatigue and Student Burnout***
   - **Lead Researcher**: Aklavya Kumar
   - **Paper URL**: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GCnS6kl_VVaN-jITx9sfBQzqym1Ut4TVTBo4DzyOyy4/edit?usp=sharing
   - **Companion Medium Article**: https://medium.com/@aklavyakumr/cognitrack-a-brain-computer-interface-for-objective-monitoring-of-cognitive-fatigue-and-student-2f5b4cb5b3b6?sharedUserId=aklavyakumr
   - **Technical Details**: Engineered in Python and PyTorch across 500+ neural signal datasets to classify mental load and predict student and workplace burnout.
3. **Penn State College of Medicine — PULSE Program**
   - Selected as 1 of 30 students statewide across Pennsylvania for a 12-week longitudinal clinical medicine pathway involving 40+ hours of physician shadowing and problem-based learning (PBL) diagnostic cases.

## Autonomous Robotics & Precision Engineering
1. **FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) — Build & Programming Lead**
   - **Current Team**: FTC 8468 The Javengers (Mechanicsburg, PA; sponsored by Optum, TE Connectivity, Bank of America, UnitedHealth Group; http://www.pacar-robotics.org). Previously competed for three seasons with FTC 14464 BotBusters.
   - **Technical Stack**: Millimeter-accurate Java autonomous pathing using RoadRunner, PedroPathing, and OpenCV computer vision; CAD design in OnShape and Autodesk Fusion 360.
   - **Honors**: FIRST Dean's List Semi-Finalist (Top 40 statewide in Pennsylvania); 3x PA State Championship Finalist; winner of 12 team awards (Control, Inspire, Motivate, Connect, and Think). Directs summer robotics camps for 40+ youth.
2. **Science Olympiad — Varsity Competitor & Lead Robotics Developer**
   - **Team Standing**: Led Cumberland Valley High School's 20+ member roster to 19th Place Nationally (2024) and 20th Place Nationally (2025), earning 30+ build and lab medals across MIT, UPenn, Solon, Battle of Valley Forge, and Penn State invitationals.
   - **Hardware Built**: Hovercraft (3rd Place at MIT Invitational), Electric Vehicle (4th Place at Penn State), Robot Tour (5th Place; open-source at https://github.com/Fe4Rless233/Robot-Tour), and Helicopter.
